Is there flexibility to: 1) convert unused speaker codes into attendee trial codes and 2) get the expiration extended by two weeks so we can redistribute? We need an answer before we send the attendee update at 3pm PT.

Hi Camille,

Sorry to hear about the keynote — we can help. Short answer: yes, we can convert the standby speaker credits to attendee trial codes and push the expiration, but I need to confirm a couple of things for compliance and billing:

- Confirm total codes to move: you listed ~120 — please confirm exact number.
- Do the redistributed codes need customized metadata (utm_campaign or partner_tag) or can we use a generic attendee code set?
- Do you want the trial length changed (we can do 30 -> 60 days for a temporary promo, or keep 30 and extend the redemption window by 14 days)?

If you confirm, I can prepare a CSV of codes and a short MAP (Marketing Acceptance Policy) addendum for signatures. We can also set a one-time grace on usage limits to avoid throttling for new sign-ups.

I can cut this over quickly — ping me with the number and your preferred expiration.

Best,
